```yaml
name: Claude Code

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: 'Issue number to fix'
        required: true
        type: string
      instructions:
        description: 'Optional instructions for Claude'
        required: false
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: claude-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify-maintainer:
    name: Verify Maintainer
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
    steps:
      - name: Check if caller is a collaborator
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const { GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_ACTOR } = process.env;
            const [owner, repo] = GITHUB_REPOSITORY.split('/');
            const { data: membership } = await github.repos.getCollaboratorPermissionLevel({
              owner,
              repo,
              username: GITHUB_ACTOR
            });
            if (!['admin', 'write'].includes(membership.permission)) {
              core.setFailed(`User ${GITHUB_ACTOR} does not have write/admin permission`);
            }
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  run-claude:
    name: Run Claude Code
    needs: verify-maintainer
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get issue details
        id: issue
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const issueNumber = process.env.ISSUE_NUMBER;
            const { data: issue } = await github.issues.get({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: issueNumber
            });
            core.setOutput('body', issue.body);
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}

      - name: Run Claude Code
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are a helpful assistant. Based on issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}:
            Issue body:
            ${{ steps.issue.outputs.body }}
            Instructions:
            ${{ github.event.inputs.instructions }}
            Generate code changes to fix the issue. Output only the diff in unified format.
          timeout_minutes: 20
          max_turns: 1
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Apply Claude Code changes
        if: steps.claude.outputs.execution_file != ''
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git apply ${{ steps.claude.outputs.execution_file }}

      - name: Check if changes were made
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          if [ -f ${{ steps.claude.outputs.execution_file }} ] && [ -s ${{ steps.claude.outputs.execution_file }} ]; then
            echo "changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create draft PR
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changes == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          title: "Claude Code: Fix issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}"
          body: |
            This PR was automatically generated by Claude Code to address issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}.
            Instructions: ${{ github.event.inputs.instructions }}
          base: main
          branch: claude-fix-${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          draft: true
          assignees: ${{ github.actor }}
```
